imageAlt: Heat film for heating the terrarium floor - NS Reptiles

description.html: A heat film is a thin, flexible heating sheet placed under the terrarium floor to warm the substrate from below. The photo shows the heating strips and copper conductors along the edges of the film. This kind of heating suits species that absorb warmth through their belly from the ground, such as leopard geckos and fat-tailed geckos, and works as a supplementary heat source for snakes.
The film gives off no light, so it can stay on at night when the main lamp is off. We sell it in several sizes; tell us the floor dimensions of your terrarium and we will recommend the right one.

Stick or place the film outside, under the floor, so it covers roughly a third of the area on one side. This creates a warm and a cool zone, and the animal chooses where to be. The terrarium floor should be slightly raised so air can circulate under the film.

Always connect the film to a thermostat with the probe on the floor above the heated zone, because without control it can overheat. Do not fold it sharply or use a damaged film. Find thermostats and thermometers in our equipment range.
